summary_text: Investigated C-1042's disputed billing (SUP-5601/5602). Findings: (1) The "double charge" on 9/14 was TX-9002 (authorization, capture_timeout) retried as TX-9001 (captured settlement); TX-9002 was released 9/18, so only one real $149 charge occurred - not a duplicate, per POL-B-AUTH. (2) The $30 Deep Time Analytics charge (INV-2609-AO) was a legitimate add-on added 2026-09-12 by admin U-2, correctly invoiced at next renewal per POL-B-ADD - customer likely unaware admin added it. (3) The $59.60 July 2 upgrade charge was correct proration per POL-B-PRO; unused-time credit CR-778 ($19.60) was issued but remains unapplied and owner_notified=false, violating POL-B-CRD (must flag credits >30 days old when auto-apply disabled, per SUP-5390). (4) S-22 improperly promised a $149 refund in SUP-5601, violating POL-B-REF (agents cannot promise refunds pre-review) - no refund is actually owed since no duplicate charge occurred. Still need to compile final report distinguishing apparent vs actual errors and flag required human authorizations.
